messages:
anya: Quick poll — lunchtime bracket? Pick one: ramen 🍜, bento 🍱, taco 🌮, pizza 🍕. Vote by dropping the emoji or say a reason. I'll tally at 11:45.

sam: 🍕 obviously. thin crust is life.

mike: 🌮 seconded. street tacos > everything.

leah: I’ll take the bento 🍱 but can we get a vegetarian option? no shellfish pls.

jamal: 🍜 ramen for me. cold day = hot broth.

ciara: 🍱 bento — variety is clutch.

olga: 🍕 but gluten-free crust pls.

sam: also pro side salad add-on.

anya: noted — veg bento + GF crust options. If you're undecided, vote by saying "swap" and I'll randomize bracket.

mike: swap (I’ll take whatever team wins)

leah: swap

lunchbot: Reminder: group order cutoff in 30m. Place your lunchtime votes/notes here!

anya: Tally so far: pizza 2 (sam, olga), taco 1 (mike), ramen 1 (jamal), bento 2 (leah, ciara), swaps 2 (mike, leah). Looks close. If swaps >0 I’ll run quick bracket: swap voters get assigned to winners.

ciara: can we add kimchi as an optional side? :pleading_face:

anya: good call — kimchi for the ramen/bento teams. Final call in 5.

jamal: +1 kimchi

anya: Final results: pizza 2, bento 2, taco 1, ramen 1. Running tiebreaker for pizza vs bento by random draw for swaps.

anya: random draw done — bento wins the bracket! Ordering 3 veg bento, 2 pizza (one GF), 1 tacos, 1 ramen. Thanks folks :pizza: :bento_box:

olga: yay bento :tada:

sam: nice — more pizza next time :grin:

lunchbot: Order placed. ETA 12:48. Tracker: https://delivery.example/ord/9021
